protocol: Three fresh starts of the same nine-HTTP-worker native Qwen2.5-7B BF16 binary on GPUs 6 and 7. Six scheduled waves per start, eight sessions per wave split across two spawned independent router processes. Four tasks per client staggered at 25ms. Standard 100-entry history, 100ms simulated tool waits, alternating two and 96 document entries per report, natural stop, no prewarm. Block b assigns round-robin, observed-capacity or defer-cold-prefill via (b + [0,1,2,2,1,0][wave]) mod 3. Seed = 761 + 40*wave + 20*client + index. Same input and ordinal for each policy across restarts. Model binary SHA-256 506b3e2519dd3c3dbb35c05f966b0fab339ae3326c5ecf21b0e8c118c1a015d6.
outcomes: First and last visible final content from workflow start, final-content gap p95, both tool payloads, numeric answers, citations, natural stop, all errors, actual holds or missing readiness, destination, GPU warm goodput and separately whole block allocated GPU hours. Reconstruct correctness and normalize live tool IDs to compare input opportunities. Customer traffic still untested.
decision: General default promotion requires defer to achieve at least the correct and 10s/18s/150ms-SLO counts of BOTH controls, strictly higher SLO completions per warm GPU-hour than BOTH (sum of SLO completions / sum of warm GPU-seconds), and no matched wave exceeding either control by more than 5% on first-final, last-final or gap tail for correct completions. Each matched wave has only eight sessions; also show both latency tails on common-correct seeds. Record how often deferral was actually triggered. Failed gates retain overload-only scope. Staging screen, no deployment.
